title: 2000 Topps - Topps Collection #321 Kurt Warner Rams
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: For avid fans of the National Football League (NFL), here's a rare sports trading card from the 2000 Topps Collection featuring Kurt Warner (#321) of the St. Louis Rams. This base set card with a Topps Collection parallel/variety is perfect for collectors who are looking for a unique addition to their memorabilia. The card is in excellent shape, ready for display or storage. It's a must-have for those who want to complete their collection of NFL trading cards from the 2000 season.
